landing.hero.title: Three contractors — and an honest explanation of why
landing.hero.subtitle: Tell us the city, date, event type and budget. We drop the booked and the unsuitable, and explain each pick with numbers and facts from the profile.
landing.how.title: How it works
landing.how.step1.title: Your request
landing.how.step1.text: City, date, event type, category and budget. Optionally, duration and language.
landing.how.step2.title: Honest filters
landing.how.step2.text: We drop anyone booked on the date, over budget, or not taking your format or language — and keep track of who and why.
landing.how.step3.title: Up to three explained picks
landing.how.step3.text: Every explanation cites facts: price and budget margin, formats, languages, hours and a quote from the profile.
landing.example.title: What an explanation looks like
landing.example.query: Request: Almaty · 17 October · wedding · host · up to ₸1,000,000 · Kazakh · 8 h
landing.example.card1: Weddings are her niche: she only takes weddings and toi, and her profile mentions “356 свадеб” over 13 years. From ₸900,000, leaving ₸100,000 of budget; the price was filled in during data prep, so double-check it.
landing.example.card2: The only one of the three who also hosts in English, and the profile names bride send-off and first-steps ceremonies. Up to 10 h on site, 2 h more than your 8 h; from ₸900,000.
landing.example.card3: An actor and TV host per the profile, hosts in Kazakh. From ₸1,000,000, exactly your budget, so the final price may be higher; 8 h max, no slack.
landing.honesty.title: If there is no match, we tell you why
landing.honesty.found: Found 3 of 10 Almaty hosts for 17 October — the rest are booked, over budget or don’t take weddings.
landing.honesty.nocat: There are no decorators in Astana — Almaty has 3, 2 of them synthetic.
landing.honesty.none: On 26 December 9 of 10 Almaty hosts are booked, and the free one doesn’t host toi. With ₸900,000, two are free on 27 December.

landing.faq.title: Questions
landing.faq.a1: Matching will not require signing in. An account will let you keep your search history and favourites.
landing.faq.q2: Where does the data come from?
landing.faq.a2: From an anonymised catalog of {profiles} contractors provided by Firebird. {synthetic} profiles are synthetic, and we flag them.
landing.faq.a3: Matching is designed to use a transparent score from budget fit, specialisation, profile relevance and experience. A breakdown will be available under each card.
landing.faq.a4: Matching will be deterministic: the same request will always return the same order.
